g.text: NSS pulled up: radio stays deselected while the ESP32 boots.

g.desc: NSS pulled up: radio stays deselected while the ESP32 boots.

g.text: Antenna: U.FL + 868 MHz pigtail (default) or 82 mm quarter-wave wire on J4 (DNP).

g.desc: Antenna: U.FL + 868 MHz pigtail (default) or 82 mm quarter-wave wire on J4 (DNP).

g.text: Firmware: 865-867 MHz, PA_BOOST +17 dBm (RFO unused), SF7-SF9/125 kHz, duty <= 2.5 %.

g.desc: Firmware: 865-867 MHz, PA_BOOST +17 dBm (RFO unused), SF7-SF9/125 kHz, duty <= 2.5 %.

g.text: CC1/CC2 5.1k pull-downs = USB-C sink (5 V default current). RPROG 5.1k -> I_REG = 1000 V / 5.1k = 196 mA (0.5 C).

g.desc: CC1/CC2 5.1k pull-downs = USB-C sink (5 V default current). RPROG 5.1k -> I_REG = 1000 V / 5.1k = 196 mA (0.5 C).

g.text: LED1 lights while charging (STAT low). TP6/TP7 = 2 mm pogo targets: the cassette can charge pucks without USB.

g.desc: LED1 lights while charging (STAT low). TP6/TP7 = 2 mm pogo targets: the cassette can charge pucks without USB.

g.text: Wake logic: DRV5032FB (omnipolar, push-pull, 5 Hz) runs from VBAT and drives the LDO EN.

g.desc: Wake logic: DRV5032FB (omnipolar, push-pull, 5 Hz) runs from VBAT and drives the LDO EN.

g.text: Puck in cassette (magnet) -> OUT low -> LDO off, ESP32 unpowered (storage drain ~3 uA total).

g.desc: Puck in cassette (magnet) -> OUT low -> LDO off, ESP32 unpowered (storage drain ~3 uA total).

g.text: Puck leaves the tube -> OUT high -> 3V3 up -> ESP32-C3 boots and joins the relay chain.

g.desc: Puck leaves the tube -> OUT high -> 3V3 up -> ESP32-C3 boots and joins the relay chain.

g.text: VBAT/2 divider -> IO0 (ADC1_CH0): 4.2 V -> 2.1 V, constant 2.1 uA drain.

g.desc: VBAT/2 divider -> IO0 (ADC1_CH0): 4.2 V -> 2.1 V, constant 2.1 uA drain.

g.text: E. Power flags, GPIO map, notes

g.desc: E. Power flags, GPIO map, notes

g.text: IO2 strap, 10k pull-up IO8 strap, 10k pull-up

g.desc: IO2 strap, 10k pull-up IO8 strap, 10k pull-up

g.text: IO20 STATUS_LED IO21 U0TXD test pad

g.desc: IO20 STATUS_LED IO21 U0TXD test pad

g.text: Power: USB-C/pogo 5 V -> MCP73831 -> VBAT (3.0-4.2 V)

g.desc: Power: USB-C/pogo 5 V -> MCP73831 -> VBAT (3.0-4.2 V)

g.text: Peak 3V3 load ~0.45 A (Wi-Fi TX ~0.35 A + SX1276 TX)

g.desc: Peak 3V3 load ~0.45 A (Wi-Fi TX ~0.35 A + SX1276 TX)

g.text: JST-PH polarity is NOT standard across LiPo vendors:

g.desc: JST-PH polarity is NOT standard across LiPo vendors:

g.text: check the lead before plugging (no reverse protection).

g.desc: check the lead before plugging (no reverse protection).

g.text: (same 13.2 x 16.6 mm LGA-53); verify before layout.

g.desc: (same 13.2 x 16.6 mm LGA-53); verify before layout.

g.text: Strapping: IO2 and IO8 held high (10k), IO9 = BOOT (10k up, SW2 to GND)

g.desc: Strapping: IO2 and IO8 held high (10k), IO9 = BOOT (10k up, SW2 to GND)

g.text: -> SPI boot normally, download mode with SW2. No other load on IO2/8/9.

g.desc: -> SPI boot normally, download mode with SW2. No other load on IO2/8/9.

g.text: EN: 10k + 1 uF RC delay after 3V3 rises; SW1 = reset.

g.desc: EN: 10k + 1 uF RC delay after 3V3 rises; SW1 = reset.

g.text: IO18/IO19 = native USB-Serial/JTAG: flash + console over the same USB-C.

g.desc: IO18/IO19 = native USB-Serial/JTAG: flash + console over the same USB-C.

g.text: LoRa SPI through the GPIO matrix (SX1276 max 10 MHz SCK).

g.desc: LoRa SPI through the GPIO matrix (SX1276 max 10 MHz SCK).

g.text: DIO0/DIO1 on IO1/IO3 (deep-sleep wake capable, GPIO0-5).

g.desc: DIO0/DIO1 on IO1/IO3 (deep-sleep wake capable, GPIO0-5).

g.text: Battery ADC on IO0 = ADC1_CH0 (C3 ADC2 is uncalibrated, erratum: avoid).

g.desc: Battery ADC on IO0 = ADC1_CH0 (C3 ADC2 is uncalibrated, erratum: avoid).

g.text: IO20 drives the status LED; IO21 (U0TXD) = boot-log test pad.

g.desc: IO20 drives the status LED; IO21 (U0TXD) = boot-log test pad.
